editorial:
Imagine working your whole life at a paper mill only to get kicked to the curb without a second thought. That is exactly what happens to the main guy here, and it is honestly heartbreaking to watch at first. You will feel for him as he tries to find a new job but gets treated like garbage by everyone he meets. The movie starts off feeling like a sad drama, but it quickly turns into a wild ride. It blends dark humor with scary moments, making you laugh and cringe at the same time as he starts doing some really bad things just to feel powerful again.

The acting is top-notch and the twists will actually shock you. While some parts of the story move a bit slow in the middle, the ending makes up for it with a lot of energy. If you love stories about normal people snapping, you need to see this. To get the best experience, you should definitely stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for those crisp visuals. If you are a movie buff who loves owning discs, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is the way to go.
endingExplained: In the final act, you find out the main character actually planned his crimes to frame his old boss. He uses his knowledge of the mill to trap the man who fired him in a fake crime scene. In the end, he doesn't get away with it, but he goes to jail with a smile on his face because he finally felt like he won. It is a dark ending that shows he lost everything but found his pride.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves dark comedies and stories about revenge.
watchReasons: perfect mix of laughs and thrills
